description: GuidancePulse guidance rule configuration, v1. P025 GuidancePulse SPEC_VERSION 1.0.0. This JSON Schema is the interchange contract; the TypeScript validator in src/config/parse.ts is the authoritative checker and additionally enforces cross-field rules this schema cannot express (declared-phase membership, duplicate rule ids, full glob grammar, duplicate array entries).

defaults.description: Defaults applied to any rule that omits the field (PROJECT_BOOK §4.1).

max_successful_edits.description: Default edit budget per lease (PROJECT_BOOK §5.3). 0 means a lease never authorises a write.

phases.description: Declared phases, in order. Rule phases must be a subset of this list.

rules.description: At least one rule is required; a config that gates nothing is rejected.

applies_to.description: Relative path globs the rule protects. '**' as a whole segment matches zero or more segments; '*' and '?' stay inside one segment; '[...]' is a character class. Illegal globs (unbalanced '[', embedded '**', absolute paths, '..' segments) are rejected by the TypeScript validator.

phases.description: Phases this rule is active in. Omitted means all declared phases.

source.description: Guidance source files as literal relative paths (no globs). Must not be empty.

version.description: Config format version. Must be exactly 1.

title: GuidancePulse guidance rule configuration v1
